name: West Mountain

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate base-lodge position at 59 West Mountain Rd, west of Glens Falls (address per search).
Search summary (2026-09-30): base 460 ft, top 1,470 ft, vertical 1,010 ft (converted to metres).

Search summary (2026-09-30; Wikipedia and Adirondack regional pages): 130 skiable acres, 35 trails (30 groomed, 5 ungroomed glades), 5 lifts = 1 quad chair, 2 triple chairs and 2 magic carpets (stored as other).
Search summary (2026-09-30): 100% snowmaking; night skiing with all trails lit.

character: A ski area in Queensbury, near Glens Falls and Lake George, with about 1,010 ft of vertical, 35 trails (including five ungroomed glades) and 130 acres. All trails are lit for night skiing and snowmaking covers the mountain.
learning: Two magic carpets serve beginners (search summary). Lessons and rentals were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Dec 12, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.
